scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for the fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph only, not a general projective-plane family.
The known metric dimension five is prior work and not a novel claim.
The metric-basis exchange census relies on two fully explicit exhaustive finite checkers; it has not undergone independent scholarly review.
Complete primary text of a 2021 symmetric-design metric-basis study and a 2026 metric-basis-reconfiguration thesis was not available; a historical equivalent metric result cannot be ruled out.
title: Triangular blocks and shortest-path geometry of the Heawood metric-basis exchange graph
